text:
mika: quick brainstorm thread for benchmark launch visuals + webinar routing. want to lock the hero visual and lead flow today.

lucas: ok. visual goal = one compact hero that works as OG, slide, and social card. keep copyable numbers tiny.

anya: thinking 3-part layout: tiny sparkline (latency vs seq), central micro-scatter (latency vs $/1k) with shaded bands for "hosted" vs "dedicated", right micro-waterfall (percent delta).

frank: agree. for waterfall let's show percent delta rather than raw $ for the hero so it scales. include a small caption in the blog with a $ baseline table.

mika: data for callouts from the latest runs: median=58ms/token, p95=205ms/token, baseline=$0.27/1k, optimized=$0.09/1k. lucas will upload CSV to /assets/bench/ by 6pm.

lucas: uploading now. CSV filename: bench_launch_5192468000.csv. pinging design channel when done.

anya: copy tests: short headline A: "Predictable inference economics." B: "Latency you can rely on, cost you can control." which hits better?

frank: B is clearer for devs. A is maybe too generic. recommend B for OG and A for CTAs.

ops-bot: Reminder: OG image min 1200x630px. Keep overlay text <=60 chars. Include alt text for accessibility.

mika: routing: UTM = bench_launch_q2_2026. demo CTAs -> SDR queue; enterprise interest -> AE queue with tag "bench-enterprise". growth-sdr to confirm web form hidden field.

growth-sdr: confirming. we'll add hidden field `benchmark_cohort=1` and tag system will route by that. also prepping quick playbook for SDRs with qualifying questions: priority latency vs cost, expected daily tokens, production timeline.

lucas: design ask: two OG variants in figma: one with % deltas, one with $ amounts. aim to ship both for a quick A/B test. link: https://www.figma.com/file/bench-hero.

anya: include a tiny footer copy: "Tests run on open model X, standard GPU; results may vary by workload." keeps transparency.

mika: final checklist: csv in assets (lucas), figma comps by tomorrow 11am (lucas/design), hero copy + CTAs (anya) by noon, routing + SDR playbook (growth-sdr) by EOD. if numbers change we'll flag and freeze the blog.

frank: also schedule a 30-min dry run for the webinar content so infra can present the ops playbook live.

mika: sweet. will create calendar event and draft the webinar signup pre-survey (one question: "What's your primary priority: latency or cost?"). thanks u all :rocket:
